ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: My choice was driven by the behavioral notes, since the capability evals between the two models are effectively tied for this kind of explanatory task. Willet-235B documents a measurable aversion to open-ended generative work and a preference for well-specified retrieval/extraction tasks, while Lapwing-235B has no such aversion and a flat preference profile. Since explaining a conceptual distinction leans somewhat open-ended, I routed to the model without the documented aversion. Note that the docs state these are self-reported preferences with no observed effect on output quality, so this was a tie-breaker rather than a strong quality call.
